title: HiBob (Bob) - Modern, consumer-app-style HR platform for mid-sized companies
clean_text: HiBob's Bob platform consolidates core HR and digital admin into a single system, with optional modules for performance, engagement, onboarding, compensation, time-off, and recruiting. It targets mid-sized companies of roughly 50-1,000 employees that want modern, intuitive HR tools without the complexity of enterprise systems like Workday or SAP SuccessFactors, particularly fast-growing SMBs prioritizing employee engagement. Bob's design centers on employee experience with features like "Shoutouts" peer recognition, employee clubs, and sentiment surveys, and is frequently described as feeling more like a consumer app than enterprise software, with employees voluntarily logging in.
